title: REVIEW-001: note, highlight, underline, strikeout and squiggly tools in the GUI
acceptance: all five markup kinds are reachable from the GUI Comments panel and apply to the real text selection; squiggly has a real writer and appearance; tests cover all five; REVIEW-001 becomes verified on the gui host.
notes: ADR 0009 row 7. Note and highlight were wired; underline/strikeout existed in the library; squiggly was missing.
